text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, shortly before the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). In the Trainer's room...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mmhââ Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove's smartphone received a 
notification. When she checked it—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What... in the... !?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
My mother... is apparently coming to watch 
the Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...And while they're at it, they said 
they'd like to see their trainer's 
face..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: For tomorrow...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I cannot just stand idle...! I must not 
commit any blunder!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We will begin preparations now. You will 
assist me—that is an order!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I heard about them from Air Groove 
before, they sounded cheerful, but... are 
they actually terrifying when angered?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, swept along by Air Groove's 
sheer intensity, I found myself rushing 
around preparing— thoroughly cleaning the 
Trainer's Office and more...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day. The time came for Air 
Groove's mother to arrive—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, your attire is in order. Make sure 
to keep it that way.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fool! Why would I be nervous?! She's my 
own mother!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If it were just me alone, it wouldn't have 
turned out like this— Hey, you! Don't you 
dare say anything unnecessary!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, there you are! Air Groove~! Long time 
no see~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Mother!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume is waving over there. She 
must be Air Groove's mother.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere was far brighter than I had 
imagined—quite different from Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry about dropping in so suddenly, 
okay? I just really wanted to see it up 
close.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for going out of your way to 
come. Standing and talking is awkward, so 
please, come this way. I've prepared a 
place for us to sit.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Prepared as always~! Hard to believe 
you're my daughter! Ah—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Are you my daughter's Trainer?! Nice to 
meet you~! Thank you so much for taking 
care of her!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Has my girl been causing you any trouble? 
She can be a bit fiery, as you know.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
M-Mother! Please stop talking about 
that...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh~~? But it's true! You do have a bit 
of a shy side, you know."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: L-Like I said!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems even Air Groove is no match for 
this mother...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing Air Groove genuinely flustered and 
blushing felt so refreshing that it 
brought a smile to my face."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I guided Air Groove's mother into the 
Trainer's Office—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Heh~, so this is where you and Air Groove 
are always working hard together~.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, oh, I see, I see~ ...Ah! Are these 
New Year decorations stored away in here?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This is what we decorate the 
Trainer's Room with every year.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just as Mother taught me—cherishing the 
seasonal events brings a fine rhythm to 
daily life.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: Fufu, gotcha~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Look at this Trainer's office. It has no 
sense of season whatsoever, does it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Valuing annual traditions and giving life 
rhythm is essential to having a fulfilling 
year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I see, it seems Air Groove's obsession 
with annual events was inherited from her 
mother...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well then Mother, please take a seat over 
there. I will go brew some tea—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: Alriiiight, having a seat now! *heave-ho*

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
......Trainer-san. Are you having fun at 
the festival with her?
choice_data_list: What do you mean by that...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see, she never used to know how 
to relax... I don't know who she gets it 
from, but she's always pushing herself so 
hard.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't just stand by, so back then I 
told them, "You need to relax more!" and 
dragged them along to all sorts of 
festivals~.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Well, part of it is simply that I love 
festivals and wanted to have fun with my 
daughter, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
“Still, she was enjoying herself, too. 
Just as I was thinking 'Thank goodness'—”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I guess somewhere along the way, I started 
taking festivals way too strictly...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"I wondered if that's how you felt too, 
Trainer. It made me a little worried."
choice_data_list: I'm having fun right along with you!
I'm having fun right alongside you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh—well that's wonderful! Please continue 
to keep my daughter company for her 
"festivals."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Afterward, I served tea in the trainer's 
office and had a long chat with Air 
Groove's mother."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thrilled to have a conversation 
with her mother after so long, Air Groove 
wore a smile the entire time...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, we talked so long it's already this 
late! I need to check into the hotel...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for telling me so much today. Mom 
feels so relieved now~.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That is wonderful to hear.
choice_data_list: I had fun talking with you too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really!? I have plenty more stories, 
you know~ Like the time she got frightened 
by thunder when she was little—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mother! Don't you have a hotel check-in to 
get to?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right, that's right! Well then, 
I suppose it's about time I take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: —Hey, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: What I said earlier was true, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"She said she was relieved. Your mother 
was really worried about you, you know~."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You're reliable to a fault, but geez, are 
you stubborn!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, you're way too hard on 
yourself! You're so stoic it's sometimes 
borderline scary. I always worry you don't 
know how to pace yourself~.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: T-Totally creeped out...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Still—if it were just strict and nothing 
else, it seems it would've disappeared 
long ago.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
When you're with your trainer, you seem 
so... confident.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Please continue to take good care 
of my daughter, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, my daughter... has such a 
wonderful look on her face now!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
—You too, Air Groove! Make sure you 
cherish your Trainer, alright?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's not as though... I don't trust you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Jeez~! Stiff, stiff, you're still way too 
stiff! Learn to be a bit more honest with 
yourself, will ya?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I-I'll do my best...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: Do you really understand? Good grief...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Well, Mom's gotta get going soon. Good 
luck in the Tenno Sho, alright!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove's mother remained full of 
boundless energy right up until the moment 
she departed...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for speaking with my mother.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mother looked... so very happy, too.
choice_data_list: She's a great mom, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. She's a mother to be proud of.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right before the major race, it was a day 
where I caught a glimpse of a brand-new 
side to Air Groove.
